final_draft.answer: Two. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule applies to administrators as well.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:29c5ee33-9de6-46c9-a140-144a1a0a2: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:3fee10be-81d2-462d-ae3b-2ee28f262: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:5b0b3fa0-d938-41c9-99f5-5d41367a7: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:c1cf3bc7-45bc-4c88-af36-f438d0009: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:3701662b-6ddd-4198-b2a1-8075edeae: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
